t: 5-in-1 multi-tacker drives staples accurately over wire with integrated guide. Shoots heavy and light duty staples, cable staples, narrow flat staples and 18 gauge brad nails. Stapler conveniently hangs from belts and pockets with a reversible belt clip.
b: 6, 8, 10, 11, 12 & 14 mm Type-G/ A/ E/ 7/ , Arrow T-50 & T-20 Staples
Interchangeable Left or Right Belt Clip
